title: 人間と自然セミナーⅡ
subtitle: Humanity and Nature Seminar II
courseType:
Humanities and Social Sciences Program
Liberal Arts and Sciences Courses
Humanity and Nature
educationalGoal: To develop leadership and judgement through interpersonal interaction. To learn abilities of leadership and judgement naturally through the oceanic activity and the group discussion. To sing the national anthem at the morning & evening color of the gathering, students aware as Japanese. To learn the knowledge, role, responsibility of engineer through the lecture. Leave from the regular campus life, students review themselves during staying in the great nature of Anamizu seminar house.
advice: This seminar consists of life-related events, the oceanic activity and the group discussion. (Summary of lectures) 1 Life-related events: Through the community life which requires independently and voluntarily manners, students aware rules, roles, responsibilities, also learn the ability of consideration, leadership and team-work. To listen to the speech, sing the national anthem at the morning & evening color of the gathering, students deeply aware as Japanese and learn the manner of human society. 2 Oceanic activity: Students experience the sailing and orienteering to operate cutters. Through this activity students learn about leadership, judgement and the importance of team-work. 3 Group discussion: Select one within “contribute to the societies” themes which based on KIT IDEALS, each group do a brain-storming, make a story and present a speech. 4 Lecture: Learn about “Japanese security” to aware the basic ability about the national security. (Advice for the seminar) 1 Have a good sleep to prepare for this seminar. If you are poor condition at departure, report it to the instructor. 2 Recommend to read the files in the syllabus of “humanity and nature seminar 2” prior to the seminar. 3 In this seminar, to share each other abilities, support each other, positive attitude are essence.
